Research Areas
HKU offers PhD and MPhil programmes in all faculties and schools/departments. Applicants will be requested to indicate the proposed department or interdisciplinary research area in the application based on your areas of interest. The list of faculties, schools/departments and interdisciplinary research areas admitting research postgraduate students are listed below. You may also search for potential supervisor from the HKU Scholars Hub.
Note: Academic units admitting research postgraduate students are marked with # in the list.

​​Notes:

2. The School of Computing and Data Science was established in July 2024. The new School shall encompass the two existing Teaching Departments (viz. Department of Computer Science and Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science).
3. Department of Industrial and Manufacturing Systems Engineering has been renamed as Department of Data and Systems Engineering in September 2024.
4. Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering has been renamed as Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering in February 2026.
5. The School of Innovation was established in November 2024 and is allocated to the Faculties of Architecture, Business and Economics, Engineering and Science.
